stages.title: Onboarding
stages.desc: Neeche message mein apna Instagram page link, niche aur goal bhejo. Hum samajhte hain aap abhi kahan ho.

stages.title: Content analysis
stages.desc: Hamari team aapke page aur reels dekh kar analysis karti hai — kya chal raha hai, kya nahi.

stages.title: Feedback aur refine
stages.desc: Aapko saaf feedback milta hai: hook, story, editing aur posting mein kya badalna hai.

stages.title: Saath mein grow
stages.desc: Aap naye reels banate ho, team review karke unhe refine karne mein madad karti hai.

stages.title: Aage ka plan
stages.desc: Results dekh kar aage ka plan: kya post karna hai aur kab.
